newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, Hewlett-Packard to co-operate in autos.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, Hewlett-Packard to co-operate in autos.

text.p: German electronics giant Siemens AG said on Tuesday it wanted to start long-term co-operation with U.S. firm Hewlett-Packard Co in developing tools for auto electronics.
The firms will cooperate on special tools for the development of motor and gearbox controls.
In the future Hewlett-Packard would then take over the specialist tools from Siemens and offer them to the auto and auto delivery industry.

Siemens said it wanted to build up its international competitive position in so-called "application tools" by teaming up with the world market leader in measuring and analytic technology in the field of automobile technology.
